C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including normalization, common denominators, borrowing, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number, mixed number, or fraction into a subtraction-ready equivalent form such as adding a zero fractional part, simplifying a fractional part, or converting an improper mixed-number part to a proper mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/n before subtracting mixed-number parts.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a fractional part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator for unlike fractions.
Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction after the numbers are already in usable form.
Do not tag when the step only combines final whole and fractional parts into the answer.

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Create equivalent fractions with a common denominator so fractional parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractions.
Tag when the solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag when mixed-number fraction parts are rewritten to a shared denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when the step only rewrites a whole number as having fractional part 0/n.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators or whole parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with aligned denominators and/or subtract whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers when no regrouping is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers directly without borrowing.
Tag when the solution combines the direct subtraction results into the final mixed number or fraction when no regrouping step is required.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the key step is borrowing or regrouping because the fractional subtraction would be negative.
Do not tag when the step only normalizes operands before subtraction.
Do not tag when the step only simplifies a non-reduced result after subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow 1 whole into fractional units when needed and reduce resulting fractions or zero fractions to lowest terms.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when the solution completes subtraction after regrouping.
Tag when the solution simplifies a resulting fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/n to 0.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when subtraction is completed directly without any regrouping or simplification step shown.
Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator.
Do not tag when the step only rewrites operands into equivalent starting forms.

B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into compatible fractional forms before subtraction by finding a common denominator, rewriting a whole number with a zero fractional part, or normalizing a mixed number whose fractional part is improper.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution explicitly finds an LCD or converts unlike fractions to equivalent fractions with a common denominator.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number such as n + 0/d to support part-by-part subtraction.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fractional part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when fractions already have compatible denominators and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag simple subtraction of already-aligned whole or fractional parts.
Do not tag final simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts separately once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts numerators over a shared denominator.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fraction parts separately in a mixed-number problem.
Tag when the solution performs the main subtraction after any needed rewriting or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators or rewrite forms before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps used to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag simplification-only or combine-only steps after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to continue subtraction when the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole-number part and converts it to d/d in the fractional part.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is repaired by regrouping before completing the subtraction.
Tag when the borrowed whole is combined with the existing fractional part to form an improper fraction for subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction; that belongs to form alignment.
Do not tag final simplification or combining of the answer.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and express it appropriately as a fraction, mixed number, or whole number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when the solution combines a whole-number part and fractional part into a mixed number or integer final answer.
Tag when the solution recognizes that a zero fractional part leaves a whole number only.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself.
Do not tag denominator alignment or rewriting before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping steps.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Create equivalent fractions
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number subtraction if the fraction parts are rewritten to a common denominator before subtracting.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of denominator matching with no equivalent-fraction conversion.
Do not tag simplification such as 4/10 to 2/5; that is not creating a common denominator.

skills.name: Rename numbers for subtraction
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity into a more workable form for subtraction, such as normalizing a mixed number with an improper fraction part, simplifying a fraction part inside a mixed number, or expressing a whole number as a mixed number with 0 fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtracting, such as 3 4/10 to 3 2/5.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with 0 fractional part, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5 or 2 to 2 + 0/3.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to regrouping, not initial renaming.
Do not tag finding a common denominator by converting to equivalent fractions; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag the final combining of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction is performed after normalization or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create equivalent fractions or rename numbers before subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing a whole into fractional units; that belongs to regrouping.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: When subtraction produces a negative fractional part or a reducible/zero fraction, borrow from the whole part as needed and express the final answer in lowest terms or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into fractional units to continue subtraction.
Tag when a resulting fraction is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when a zero fraction is simplified to 0 or the final result is expressed as an integer after simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction that does not require borrowing or simplification.
Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction; that belongs to S01.
